video_script_25s.layout: 70% left Oxide Studio GUI, 30% right MCP client / Terminal + Ableton Live 12 ready for final .als drop

segments.action: Send MCP prompt: 'Create a 132 BPM dark techno pattern: 909 rumble kick, Euclidean hi-hats (7/16), and a resonant 303 bassline in F minor'. Clips populate in Session Matrix, notes draw in Piano Roll with Scale-Fold, audio drops immediately.
segments.caption: Native Rust DAW (60 FPS egui + lock-free DSP) controlled live via MCP

segments.action: Grab the mouse and drag the 8-Macro XY Perform Pad with Orbit LFO spinning live while Auto Filter cutoff and Roar multiband saturation open up on the 303.
segments.caption: Zero-allocation audio thread: FM Operator, Wavetable, 909, Roar & 8-Macro XY Pad

segments.action: Trigger 4-band Stem Separation (Kick+Sub, Bass, Synths/Mids, Hats/Air) and twist the Euclidean Generator density knob in real time.
segments.caption: Real-time 4-Band Stem Separation & Generative Euclidean MIDI

segments.action: Click Export .als in Oxide Studio -> drag the generated .als file straight into Ableton Live 12 -> show identical tracks, BPM, and MIDI clips playing back inside Live 12.
segments.caption: Bidirectional Ableton Live 12 (.als) interop. 100% Free & MIT Open-Source.
